title: Co-PiLOT: Constrained Physics-Informed Latent Optimization for Target-Driven Inverse Design
abstract: arXiv:2609.37875v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inverse design of physical systems (molecules, devices, microstructures) often reduces to optimizing a high-dimensional structure against an expensive black-box simulator. Direct search is difficult because the space is non-Euclidean, feasibility is hard to encode, and each evaluation is expensive. We present Co-PiLOT, a latent optimization approach that maps candidates through a generative encoder-decoder, uses the decoder as a learned validity prior, and searches the latent space with physics-informed black-box optimization. The framework is applied on the inverse design of magnesium alloy microstructure/texture. We develop a vision transformer based-encoder; paired with latent diffusion, diffusion transformer and rectified-flow transformer-based decoders on $\sim80{,}000$ EBSD-derived microstructure dataset to learn a minimal bottleneck, $z$. The ViT-FMDiT model ($z$=$768$) reconstructs high-fidelity microstructure images (FID $27.86$

translated_title: Co-PiLOT：面向目标驱动逆向设计的约束物理信息潜在优化
translated_abstract: 物理系统（如分子、器件、微观组织）的逆向设计通常可归结为：针对昂贵的黑盒模拟器来优化一个高维结构。直接搜索之所以困难，是因为该结构空间是非欧几里得的，可行性难以编码，且每次评估代价高昂。我们提出 Co-PiLOT，这是一种潜在优化方法：通过生成式编码器-解码器对候选方案进行映射，将解码器作为学习到的有效性先验，并在潜在空间中利用物理信息黑盒优化进行搜索。该框架被应用于镁合金微观组织/织构的逆向设计。我们开发了基于视觉Transformer（ViT）的编码器，并在约80,000个由EBSD（电子背散射衍射）衍生的微观组织数据集上，将其与基于潜在扩散、扩散Transformer和整流流Transformer的解码器配对，以学习一个最小瓶颈表示 z。ViT-FMDiT 模型（z=768）能够重建高保真度的微观组织图像（FID 27.86……）
tldr: 该论文提出 Co-PiLOT 框架，利用生成式编码器-解码器（如 ViT-FMDiT）学习微观组织的紧凑潜在表示，并在此潜在空间中结合物理信息黑盒优化进行搜索，从而实现镁合金微观组织/织构的目标驱动逆向设计。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Co-PiLOT, a framework that learns compact latent representations of microstructures via generative encoder-decoder models (e.g., ViT-FMDiT) and performs physics-informed black-box optimization in the latent space, enabling target-driven inverse design of magnesium alloy microstructure/texture.
